information.description:
Personal Humanoid Ground Drone. A humanoid telepresence drone tied to a building's architecture and run from a Neuroport (it can't leave the building's range). Robot hands (BODY 6), audio recorder, chip slot with a Memory Chip, camera with MicroVideo and LL/IR/UV. Standby: idle but recording everything to its chip. Direct Control: you run it from your Neuroport as if you held its Control Node; it can't dodge bullets.

Cost: 10,000eb
MOVE: 6
HP: 20
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
